description: This file contains setup and configuration logic for integrating Zalo messaging platform into the OpenClaw framework, including functions for setting update modes, prompting for tokens, webhook configuration, and defining a setup wizard.

methods.name: setZaloUpdateMode
methods.description: Configures the update mode (polling or webhook) for a specified Zalo account within the OpenClaw configuration.

methods.name: noteZaloTokenHelp
methods.description: Provides instructions to the user on how to obtain and set up a Zalo bot token.

methods.name: promptZaloAllowFrom
methods.description: Prompts the user to specify allowed Zalo user IDs for direct messaging policies.
